body:
Server side of protocol versioning (T-240): see the design of record.

* `server/src/shoppinglist_server/protocol.py` (PROTOCOL_VERSION = 3, PROTOCOL_HEADER).
* A blueprint-scoped `before_request` gate exactly as specified: 426 `client_outdated` with the
  server's `protocol`, before authentication, no database access, no audit record; exempt only
  `GET /app-version`; site-root routes untouched; correct with several mounted instances and with
  a url_prefix mount.
* `GET /app-version` gains `protocol`.
* Every existing server test must keep passing WITHOUT being edited one by one: make the test
  client send the current protocol header by default (conftest: the `client` fixture and every
  place tests call `app.test_client()` directly), and add a way for the new tests to send no
  header or a different one. `smoke-wheel.sh`, `dev_tls_server.py` if needed, and every curl
  example in the READMEs and docs/wire-contract.md send the header.
* docs/wire-contract.md: the header in Conventions, the "Protocol version" section with policy
  and changelog (protocol 3 / 3.0.0: ledger entry types), `426 client_outdated` in the error
  table, `protocol` in the /app-version response; server/README.md accordingly.
* AGENTS.md gets a short "Protocol" rule in the workflow/server section stating the policy
  (what bumps it, that a bump means a major release, the three constants, the changelog).
* Release guard in release.sh as specified, logic in a script the tests can call.
* No client changes here (T-244).

Tests: header missing / non-numeric / zero / negative / lower / equal / higher against a sample
of routes (login, register, sync, a lists route, admin, invites), and that /app-version is
exempt and reports the protocol; that the 426 body is the standard envelope plus `protocol`;
that the gate does no database work (a database path that does not exist still answers 426);
two instances mounted on one app; prefix mount; landing page, SPA and APK routes unaffected;
the release-guard script (all refusal cases and the pass cases incl. the previous tag without
protocol.py). Each new test must fail when its change is reverted.
title: Protocol versioning, server: header gate, 426 client_outdated, release guard
